title: Labeling Strategy Cost Calculator
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate the cost of labeling 20,000 tickets by manual labeling, AI-assisted labeling, active learning, and an outside vendor, to within the tolerance stated for each item.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the cost of labeling 20,000 tickets by manual labeling, AI-assisted labeling, active learning, and an outside vendor, to within the tolerance stated for each item.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) A vendor's quoted price per label is its true cost. (2) AI-assisted labeling cost is mostly the token charge. (3) AI-assisted labeling saves the same amount whatever the reviewer's check time.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of eight items the learner types a value before the answer is shown. A value is correct when it is within the tolerance in the Content table. Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Exploration with the adjustable quantities is not evidence.
